metadata.case_name: HO KA YIN v. EXPRESS SECURITY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: Associate degree student in the Applied Social Work programme at the Hong Kong Baptist University
plaintiff.education_level: Enrolled as an associate degree student (Applied Social Work); later admitted to the Bachelor of Social Work (Hons) in the 2008/2009 academic year (course 2008-2011), about to graduate with a full degree

injuries.description: fracture of the neck of the right femur
source: she was found to have suffered a fracture of the neck of the right femur and a fracture of the left femoral supracondylar.

injuries.description: fracture of the left femoral supracondylar
source: she was found to have suffered a fracture of the neck of the right femur and a fracture of the left femoral supracondylar.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of femur not extending into joint, simple

injuries.description: fractures to the right distal femur
source: This accident caused fractures to the right distal femur and the left proximal tibia
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of femur

injuries.description: fracture of the left proximal tibia
source: This accident caused fractures to the right distal femur and the left proximal tibia
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of tibia

manifestations.description: residual stiffness in the hip (right) after the first accident
residual stiffness in the left knee after the first accident
weakness of the muscles (grade 3 muscle power)
pain in the joints and surgical wounds during recovery
exaggerated anxiety about falling from her wheelchair and recurring nightmares (psychological sequelae)
avoidance of wheelchair lifts and fear of going out (behavioural avoidance)
reduced ability to perform activities of daily living including inability to transfer from wheelchair to bed or to toilet; needs constant care of her mother (post-second accident)

treatments_received: closed reduction and screw fixation of her right hip
k-wire fixation of the left distal femoral
application of a hip spica plaster cast
four sessions with a clinical psychologist

losses.description: After the first accident, the plaintiff found she needed to use her wheelchair to get around even at home; she could no longer use public transport and had to book a rehabilitation bus; she rarely went out.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: She is afraid of wheelchair lifts and avoids using them and avoids going to places where she would have to use them.
After the second accident she has much less ability to perform ADL, including an inability to transfer from wheelchair to bed or to toilet, and needs the constant care of her mother.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: She needs help with activities of daily life (ADL) and depends much more on her mother to take care of her; cannot bathe or use the toilet on her own post-accidents.
Her reduced ambulatory ability and need for constant care will greatly reduce her chances of gaining employment as a social worker.
